classes.name: STEPEdit
classes.summary: Provides tools to exploit and edit a set of STEP data : editors, selections ..

staticMethods.name: Protocol
staticMethods.comment: Returns a Protocol fit for STEP (creates the first time).

staticMethods.name: NewModel
staticMethods.comment: Returns a new empty StepModel fit for STEP i.e. with its header determined from Protocol.

staticMethods.name: SignType
staticMethods.comment: Returns a SignType fit for STEP (creates the first time).

staticMethods.name: NewSelectSDR
staticMethods.comment: Creates a Selection for ShapeDefinitionRepresentation By default searches among root entities.

staticMethods.name: NewSelectPlacedItem
staticMethods.comment: Creates a Selection for Placed Items, i.e. MappedItem or ContextDependentShapeRepresentation, which itself refers to a RepresentationRelationship with possible subtypes (Shape... and/or ...WithTransformation) By default in the whole StepModel.

staticMethods.name: NewSelectShapeRepr
staticMethods.comment: Creates a Selection for ShapeRepresentation and its sub-types, plus ContextDependentShapeRepresentation (which is not a sub-type of ShapeRepresentation) By default in the whole StepModel.

classes.name: STEPEdit_EditContext
classes.summary:
EditContext is an Editor fit for Product Definition Context (one per Model) , i.e. :
- ProductDefinition
- ApplicationProtocolDefinition
- ProductRelatedProductCategory

classes.name: STEPEdit_EditSDR
classes.summary: EditSDR is an Editor fit for a Shape Definition Representation which designates a Product Definition.
